scope: Compact guide item recognition; not a complete OSRS item database or universal substitute list.
important_limits: Character Export already canonicalizes noted IDs and loses raw noted status. Registry cannot reconstruct that information.
No charge counts are exported. Preserve unknown charge counts; charged forms do not prove enough casts for a trip.
Use real skill levels and verified quest states for wear gates; item ownership does not complete a quest or CA.
Unknown IDs/names must remain unknown; never use an arbitrary same-name match from tournament/quest variants.
Group IDs express narrow equipment roles and require per-task validation; they are not interchangeable for exact-item CAs.
Never sum asynchronous bank, inventory and equipment quantities without coherence evidence; dose families can overlap across locations and variant IDs.
